Typical_Circumstances: Sell-side investment banking retainers legal fees and accounting advisory incurred for transaction
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Verify expenses relate solely to transaction execution and will terminate at deal close
Required_Source_Documents: Engagement letters detailed legal invoices payment confirmations Board minutes
Testing_Procedures: Trace invoices to vendor engagement letters confirm scope is M&A-specific verify payment
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-recurring if deal-specific; recurring if corporate governance or routine legal
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost required for one-off deal advisors
Double_Counting_Risks: Verify fees were expensed in P&L and not capitalized into transaction costs or equity
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted in full if 100% deal-specific and expensed in SG&A

Typical_Circumstances: Closure of branch warehouse plant termination of headcount or plant lease exit
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Confirm site or operation is permanently shut down and terminated costs will not re-emerge
Required_Source_Documents: Executed separation agreements WARN notices lease termination releases payroll registers
Testing_Procedures: Inspect employee separation agreements verify final severance pay inspect lease cancellation
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-recurring if business unit or facility is permanently exited; recurring if ongoing turnover
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Assess whether remaining staff must absorb workload or replacement hires are needed
Double_Counting_Risks: Verify severed headcount duties are not backfilled; check accrued severance vs cash paid
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted if facility permanently shuttered and severance is legally final without backfill

Typical_Circumstances: Owner-operator draws market-rate salary or personal expenses through corporate payroll
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Normalize executive compensation to fair market value for a professional non-owner manager
Required_Source_Documents: W-2/1099 forms employment agreements third-party salary surveys (Mercer/Robert Half)
Testing_Procedures: Compare owner compensation to independent salary benchmarks for equivalent industry/scale
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-operational excess compensation above market; recurring base replacement cost remains
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Mandatory deduction of market-rate replacement executive salary plus payroll tax and benefits
Double_Counting_Risks: Check that owner bonus is not also deducted elsewhere; ensure perks are not double-added
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted net of market replacement management compensation; reject full gross add-back

Typical_Circumstances: Entity leases facilities equipment or procures services from founder-owned affiliate
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Adjust related-party transactions to arm's length fair market value (FMV)
Required_Source_Documents: Commercial lease agreements independent certified appraisal market rent comps invoices
Testing_Procedures: Obtain independent commercial appraisal calculate difference between contractual rent and FMV
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Adjustment reflects enduring operational baseline under new arm's length post-close lease
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Replacement cost is the certified market-rate rent or commercial service charge
Double_Counting_Risks: Verify whether property taxes/insurance (NNN) are shifted between landlord and tenant
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted only for variance between contractual rent and certified FMV; reject total rent

Typical_Circumstances: Damage from natural disasters storm flooding fire or catastrophic equipment failure
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Isolate true non-recurring casualty costs and ensure net of any insurance recoveries
Required_Source_Documents: Disaster inspection reports contractor repair invoices insurance claim filings check copies
Testing_Procedures: Trace repair invoices verify catastrophic origin verify if insurance recovery was received
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-recurring if caused by unpreventable external event; recurring if routine deferred maintenance
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Assess if repaired asset requires ongoing preventative maintenance at higher cost
Double_Counting_Risks: Check whether repair was capitalized into fixed assets or expensed; check insurance credit line
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted net of insurance proceeds; reject deferred maintenance disguised as casualty

Typical_Circumstances: Receipt of insurance claim settlements credited to operating P&L accounts
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Remove non-trading non-operating income credits that artificially inflate operating EBITDA
Required_Source_Documents: Insurance carrier settlement agreements remittance advices GL credit postings
Testing_Procedures: Examine settlement documentation verify corresponding historical loss period and account
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-operating income credit that will not recur in baseline operations
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost required; purely an earnings deflation adjustment
Double_Counting_Risks: Check that insurance credit does not offset an un-added back operating repair expense
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Mandatory QoE deduction to reverse non-operating earnings inflation

Typical_Circumstances: Engagements with third-party advisors for strategy IT systems or operational optimization
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Distinguish between truly non-recurring project fees and ongoing recurring advisory services
Required_Source_Documents: SOWs contracts consulting deliverables timesheets billing detail
Testing_Procedures: Review SOW deliverables interview management determine if capability is built internally or recurring
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-recurring only if finite one-time transformation (e.g. ERP cutover); recurring if operational
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Assess whether internal headcount must be hired to maintain system or strategic process
Double_Counting_Risks: Verify consulting fees were not already capitalized into balance sheet intangible assets
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Reject if routine recurring advisory or lacking timesheets/deliverables; accept if finite one-off

Category_Name: Customer Bad Debt & Credit Loss Normalization
Typical_Circumstances: Customer bankruptcy or single large default claimed by seller as exceptional non-recurring
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Assess whether credit losses represent normal operational risk of business model and trade credit
Required_Source_Documents: Bankruptcy filings customer payment history aging schedules historical write-off trends
Testing_Procedures: Examine historical bad debt write-offs over 3-5 years calculate historical percentage of revenue
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Recurring operational business risk; customer defaults occur periodically in commercial trade
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Credit loss reserve is a recurring requirement of operating a credit-granting commercial model
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure bad debt write-off is not double-counted against AR aging reserve in Working Capital
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Reject add-back if customer credit risk is within historical volatility range; rarely accepted

Typical_Circumstances: Management adds back future anticipated savings from new contracts headcount cuts or tech
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Prevent prospective unearned synergies from inflating historical maintainable earnings
Required_Source_Documents: Vendor contracts unsigned proposals management forecast models synergy decks
Testing_Procedures: Examine contract terms implementation timeline required capital expenditure realization lag
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Prospective future savings do not exist in historical actuals; purely speculative
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Requires full operational investment and execution to realize; significant downside execution risk
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure unearned savings are excluded from historical baseline and tracked in pro-forma deck
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Reject completely from Historical Normalized EBITDA; present solely as pro-forma sensitivity

Typical_Circumstances: Management expenses capitalized development or proposes add-backs for capitalized items
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Verify that claimed add-backs actually hit operating expenses and did not sit on Balance Sheet
Required_Source_Documents: Capital expenditure register WIP software capitalization schedules vendor invoices
Testing_Procedures: Inspect general ledger accounting entries trace invoice debit to fixed assets vs P&L expense
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-P&L balance sheet movements cannot be added back to EBITDA
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost; accounting boundary classification issue
Double_Counting_Risks: Direct risk of double-counting by adding back an expense that was already capitalized on BS
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Reject add-back if invoice was debited to asset accounts (ASC 350-40 / ASC 360); accept only if in P&L

Typical_Circumstances: Premature revenue recognition before delivery or FOB shipping point satisfaction (ASC 606)
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Ensure revenue and gross profit are recognized strictly in the period earned
Required_Source_Documents: Customer purchase orders bills of lading shipping manifests proof of delivery cut-off tests
Testing_Procedures: Test transactions 15 days before and after fiscal year-end verify delivery date vs invoice date
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Reversal of cut-off error shifts gross margin between fiscal periods
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost; standard GAAP timing correction
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure matching reversal of related inventory and COGS; verify AR subledger balance
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Mandatory QoE deduction to reverse unearned premature revenue and gross margin

Typical_Circumstances: Direct manual journal entries posted at period end to hit EBITDA targets without source data
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Eliminate arbitrary accounting entries that lack underlying operational transaction support
Required_Source_Documents: Manual journal entry logs journal voucher approvals source transaction listings
Testing_Procedures: Extract all manual JEs above materiality examine debit/credit lines verify lack of external invoices
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Unsupported manipulation; completely invalid for normalized maintainable earnings
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Requires complete reversal and restatement of true operational transaction volumes
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure corresponding balance sheet plug (AR Other Assets Accrued) is also eliminated
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Mandatory QoE deduction to reverse all unsubstantiated topside adjustments in full

Category_Name: Inventory Obsolescence & Lower of Cost or Market
Typical_Circumstances: Write-downs of dead excess or obsolete inventory claimed by seller as one-time charge
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Determine whether inventory write-offs represent recurring inventory management risk
Required_Source_Documents: Inventory aging schedules scrap logs physical count variances historical write-offs
Testing_Procedures: Analyze historical scrap and reserve rates evaluate SKU life-cycles inspect physical warehouse
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Recurring business risk in manufacturing and distribution; product obsolescence is ongoing
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Normal obsolescence reserve is required in baseline operations to reflect ongoing scrap
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure write-down aligns with Working Capital inventory peg calculation
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Reject add-back unless tied to discontinued product line exit; otherwise treat as recurring COGS

Typical_Circumstances: Current year P&L impacted by catch-up entries corrections of prior year errors
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Reallocate expenses and revenues to their true economic period to reflect genuine performance
Required_Source_Documents: Audit workpapers prior year tax returns reconciliation entries GL detail
Testing_Procedures: Trace prior-period errors identify original transaction dates calculate true period impact
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Out-of-period entry does not belong in current period operations; restate to prior period
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost; periodic reallocation correction
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure prior period EBITDA is restated downwards/upwards; check cumulative retained earnings
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted to remove from current year; must concurrently restate prior historical periods

Typical_Circumstances: Target acquired a business mid-year; historical actuals only include stub-period results
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Annualize acquired business performance to present a full 12-month normalized run-rate
Required_Source_Documents: Audited pre-acquisition financial statements purchase agreements stub-period management accounts
Testing_Procedures: Tie stub period to closing trial balance add verified pre-acquisition trading results
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Reflects structural change in enterprise scale; run-rate is ongoing maintainable baseline
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: Requires inclusion of full corporate overheads and eliminated duplicate redundant costs
Double_Counting_Risks: Ensure intercompany sales between target and acquired entity post-deal are fully eliminated
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted in Pro-Forma EBITDA bridge with verified pre-acquisition audited books; distinct from Historical

Typical_Circumstances: FX transaction/translation gains or losses and speculative commodity/currency derivatives
QoE_Investigation_Objective: Strip out volatile financial market fluctuations to reveal pure underlying operational earnings
Required_Source_Documents: Bank FX statements derivative settlement confirmations trade blotters hedging policies
Testing_Procedures: Inspect FX transaction vs translation accounts identify speculative vs operational hedging
Recurrence_Assessment_Criteria: Non-operational financial volatility that does not reflect core trading capability
Replacement_Cost_Assessment: No replacement cost required; financing/treasury volatility removed from operating metric
Double_Counting_Risks: Verify whether FX was booked inside COGS (operational) or below operating profit (financing)
Acceptance_Rejection_Standard: Accepted to remove speculative FX gains/losses from operating EBITDA; operational FX evaluated in COGS
